_notice: SAMPLE DATA — NOT A LIVE SECURITY SCAN. All domains and findings are synthetic for demonstration purposes.

demo_findings.title: Site does not use HTTPS
demo_findings.explanation: The site is served over plain HTTP. Traffic between the browser and server is not encrypted.
demo_findings.impact: Sensitive data including credentials, cookies, and form data may be intercepted by network attackers (MITM).
demo_findings.recommendation: Configure your web server to serve content over HTTPS using a valid TLS certificate. Redirect all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

demo_findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header
demo_findings.evidence: Header 'Strict-Transport-Security' was not present in the HTTP response.
demo_findings.explanation: HSTS instructs browsers to only communicate with the server over HTTPS for a specified period.
demo_findings.impact: Users may be vulnerable to protocol-downgrade attacks on their first visit.

demo_findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
demo_findings.evidence: Header 'Content-Security-Policy' was not present in the HTTP response.
demo_findings.explanation: CSP restricts the sources from which a browser can load scripts, styles, images, and other resources.
demo_findings.impact: Without CSP, injected scripts from XSS attacks have fewer browser-level restrictions.
demo_findings.recommendation: Define a strict Content-Security-Policy appropriate for your application. Start with: Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'

demo_findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options header (clickjacking risk)
demo_findings.evidence: Header 'X-Frame-Options' was not present in the HTTP response.
demo_findings.explanation: X-Frame-Options prevents the page from being embedded in an iframe on other domains.
demo_findings.impact: The site may be vulnerable to clickjacking attacks that trick users into unintended actions.
demo_findings.recommendation: Add: X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN if framing on the same domain is needed).

demo_findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
demo_findings.evidence: Header 'X-Content-Type-Options' was not present in the HTTP response.
demo_findings.explanation: This header prevents browsers from MIME-sniffing a response away from the declared content type.
demo_findings.impact: Some browsers may execute uploaded or linked files as scripts if MIME types are misidentified.

demo_findings.title: CORS allows all origins (wildcard)
demo_findings.explanation: The server reflects '*' allowing any website to read responses to cross-origin requests.
demo_findings.impact: Any website can make cross-origin requests and read responses.
demo_findings.recommendation: Restrict Access-Control-Allow-Origin to known trusted origins.

demo_findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy header
demo_findings.evidence: Header 'Referrer-Policy' was not present in the HTTP response.
demo_findings.explanation: Referrer-Policy controls how much referrer information is sent with requests.
demo_findings.impact: Sensitive URL parameters may be exposed in Referer headers sent to external resources.

demo_findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy header
demo_findings.evidence: Header 'Permissions-Policy' was not present in the HTTP response.
demo_findings.explanation: Permissions-Policy allows servers to control which browser features can be used by the page.
demo_findings.impact: Browser features may be accessible to third-party embedded content without restriction.

demo_findings.title: Potentially weak Content-Security-Policy configuration
demo_findings.explanation: The CSP header is present but contains 'unsafe-inline' which reduces its XSS protection effectiveness.
demo_findings.impact: Inline scripts are permitted, partially undermining XSS protection.
demo_findings.recommendation: Remove 'unsafe-inline' from script-src. Use nonces or hashes for legitimate inline scripts.
